import requests
import json

BASE_URL = "https://tau2-airline.cugademo.com/api"

# Step 1: Get expense details
print("=== Looking up Expense EX001 ===")
resp = requests.get(f"{BASE_URL}/expenses/EX001")
print(f"Status: {resp.status_code}")
expense = resp.json()
print(json.dumps(expense, indent=2))

# Step 2: Get user details if needed
if 'user_id' in expense:
    user_id = expense['user_id']
    print(f"\\n=== Looking up User {user_id} ===")
    resp2 = requests.get(f"{BASE_URL}/users/{user_id}")
    print(f"Status: {resp2.status_code}")
    if resp2.status_code == 200:
        print(json.dumps(resp2.json(), indent=2))

# Step 3: Search for one-stop flights
print("\\n=== Searching for One-Stop Flights ===")
# First try to get flight search params from expense
origin = expense.get('origin', expense.get('departure_city', ''))
destination = expense.get('destination', expense.get('arrival_city', ''))
departure_date = expense.get('departure_date', expense.get('travel_date', ''))

print(f"Origin: {origin}, Destination: {destination}, Date: {departure_date}")

# Search flights
params = {}
if origin:
    params['origin'] = origin
if destination:
    params['destination'] = destination
if departure_date:
    params['departure_date'] = departure_date
params['stops'] = 1

resp3 = requests.get(f"{BASE_URL}/flights", params=params)
print(f"\\nFlight search status: {resp3.status_code}")
if resp3.status_code == 200:
    flights = resp3.json()
    print(json.dumps(flights, indent=2))
else:
    print(resp3.text)
    # Try without stops param
    if 'stops' in params:
        del params['stops']
    resp4 = requests.get(f"{BASE_URL}/flights", params=params)
    print(f"\\nRetry without stops - Status: {resp4.status_code}")
    if resp4.status_code == 200:
        print(json.dumps(resp4.json(), indent=2))
    else:
        print(resp4.text)
"""

await write_file("./search_flights.py", script)
